sienna_cs: Heads-up  small cohort of EU onboarding jobs hit elevated latencies and intermittent 502s on 2026-03-25 between 14:05-14:32 UTC. Affected tenants: T-8802, T-8820, T-8844, T-8899.

leo_support: Confirmed. We triggered region failover to the global standby pool at 14:14 UTC which brought errors down but a few customers still saw slow completion times. Logged traces and request samples.

marta_eng: Quick tech summary: a regression in the batch scheduler caused queue head-of-line blocking under a specific multipart payload pattern. We applied a temporary limit (max_concurrent_batches=5) and restarted workers at 14:20. Hotfix in code review, expected deploy in ~3 hours after verification.

sienna_cs: Drafting customer note. Want it brief, clear on mitigations, and offering remediation help. Posting draft below  please review edits and credit language.

sienna_cs: ```Hi <CustomerContact>,

Were reaching out about a transient disruption in Redwood Dedicated (EU) on Mar 25 between 14:0514:32 UTC. During that window, some onboarding and ingest requests experienced higher latency and occasional 502 responses. This may have delayed onboarding completion for a small set of customers.

What we did: we routed traffic to the standby pool, restarted affected workers, applied temporary batching limits, and primed tenant caches to speed recovery.

How we can help: we can re-run any stalled onboarding batches for you, schedule a 30-minute remediation session with an integration engineer, and apply a one-time billing adjustment to offset retry compute. If cross-region routing is acceptable, we can also temporarily route your traffic to our global pool to speed completion; otherwise we will coordinate EU-only options.

Next steps: we will publish a technical RCA and confirmation of the permanent fix within 48 hours. Please reply if youd like a re-run, a remediation session, or prefer we not enable cross-region routing.

Regards,
Sienna (Customer Success) on behalf of Redwood Inference
```

leo_support: Suggest adding a short self-help bullet: "If youre seeing retries, reduce batch_size to 4 and add retry_backoff ~= 250ms until the patch is live."

marta_eng: Agreed. Also safe to note we observed that reducing max_tokens per call reduced memory footprint in repros.

evan_billing: Proposed credit wording (legal-approved): "A one-time credit equal to estimated retry compute during the impacted window will be applied to your next invoice. For custom adjustments, reply and we'll review usage details with you."

sienna_cs: Great. I'll add the self-help line, localize EN/FR/DE, and send once billing confirms final phrasing. Tagging renewals: flag T-8899 as high-touch follow-up due to longer delay.

ops_bot: Incident created: 2026-03-25-EU-Onboard-Latency (P2). Incident lead: marta_eng.

leo_support: I'll prepare office-hours slots Tue/Wed 13:00-15:00 UTC and include a diagnostics checklist (oauth logs, sample payloads, retry counts).

sienna_cs: Sending now after localization. Will paste sent copy and recipients here and confirm credits applied. Thanks all :thumbsup:
